The '''DAEL''' offially the '''Democratic Arten Liberal Party ([[Arten]]: ''Demosu Arten Evrelcov Lagov'')''' is a [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Liberalism liberal] [[Arten]] [[List of Arten Political Parties|political party.]] The party has been the second-largest in [[Areoix Lie]] since its foundation in 1723. The DAEL's ideology has been associated with both [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Centrism centrist] and [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Centre-right_politics centre-right policies]

The party, considered to be [[Areoix Lie|Areoix Lies]] most diverse in terms of membership and voters, draws its support predominantly from [[Arten]] speakers, people aged over 35, as well as communities from all social classes
